Compute cluster+kernel meat matrix (Driscoll-Kraay / Thompson time dimension)

Source: R/vcov-hac.R
dot-cluster_kernel_meat.Rd

Aggregates observation-level scores by time period, then accumulates kernel-weighted cross-lag products of time-clustered scores. This is the time-dimension component used by both Driscoll-Kraay (DK) and Thompson (two-way cluster+kernel) VCE.

Usage

.cluster_kernel_meat(
  basis,
  resid,
  time_index,
  kernel,
  bw,
  weights = NULL,
  weight_type = "aweight",
  center = FALSE
)

Arguments

basis

N x P matrix (X_hat for VCV, Z for diagnostics). Must be in sorted time order (matching time_index).

resid

N-vector of residuals, in sorted time order.

time_index

List from .build_time_index().

kernel

Canonical kernel name.

bw

Numeric bandwidth.

weights

Normalized weights (sorted) or NULL.

weight_type

Character: "aweight" or "pweight".

Value

P x P symmetric meat matrix (unscaled).

Details

Algorithm matches livreg2.do lines 444–535.
